title: First cut
changes: Full 60-second spot: intro, wrist close-up, walk with live app overlay, 🙈🙉🙊 cards, crowded, unfamiliar, isolated, nation and globe, end card
Unfamiliar scene: desert and Antarctica split screen
Music bed and burned-in captions only, no spoken narration (the ElevenLabs key was refused)

title: Three walkers + River narration
changes: Unfamiliar scene now has three slots: a blind walker (cane, spoken + left-ear cue), a Deaf walker (light + buzz) and a non-speaking walker (typed command)
Desert and Antarctica removed; all other scenes unchanged
ElevenLabs narration in the team's River voice, captions timed to the real clips, ending on "This is the Wayback Trail."

title: App buzzes turn you
changes: Every buzz now comes from the Wayback iPhone app: the app card shakes and the phone in the pocket ripples; the band only listens and glows

Walk scene: you ask "Take me back to the elevator", the app buzzes 2 short soft pulses (wrong_left) with a turn-left arrow until you face the route, then one long buzz (on_track, locked on), then light ticks guide you back
Narration: "Every time you ask, the Wayback app buzzes until you face the right way." and "Can't hear? The band glows, and the app buzzes."
Cards, the Deaf walker and the end card say the buzzes come from the app

label: Demo final v1
title: Working demo: phone, walker and live updates
changes: 60-second working demo: a simulated iPhone screen recording on the left; the walker and the app's live updates on the right
Everything on screen comes from running the real Wayback code (app.py, tracker, route guidance, buzz coach) on a synthetic L-shaped walk, labelled as a simulation
Start route, save the entrance and the elevator, then "Take me back to the entrance": Turn around, locked-on buzz, turn left, arrived
Hallway graphics: entrance doors, the Elevator sign at the corner, the elevator, Saved pins and green floor arrows on the way back
ElevenLabs voices: the walker (Chris), Wayback (River) and a narrator (Sarah), all captioned

label: v2 final
title: Working demo: the iPhone app's newest behaviour
changes: Matches the iPhone app's newest behaviour (branch clean-app) on main's redesigned screen
One buzz rule: silence while facing away, a steady pulse while facing the way to walk, three long buzzes on arrival
Directions spoken one at a time: "Turn around, walk 8 steps.", "In 5 steps, turn left.", "Turn left now, then walk 13 steps."
"Route started." with no hold-still wait; arrival two steps early, as the app does
The phone shows clean-app's camera picture (simulated hallway view); the status line shows what the app last said
New narrator line: "No buzz means turn. A steady pulse means you're on course."
